prompt: How do I brew different types of tea?
response: Brewing different types of tea requires varying methods. For black tea, use hot water at around 212°F and steep for 3-5 minutes. Green tea should be steeped in water heated to 180°F for 2-3 minutes. Oolong tea is steeped similarly to black tea, but for a shorter time of 2-4 minutes. Herbal teas can be steeped in hot water for 5-7 minutes. Adjust the steeping time according to your taste.
